                            │                                                              │                            
                            │  Review                         Everywhere                   │                            
                            │                                                              │                            
                            │  y       accept hunk            tab       next screen        │                            
                            │  n       drop hunk              ctrl+r    ask → review       │                            
                            │  A       accept all             ?         close              │                            
                            │  X       reject changeset       q/ctrl+c  quit               │                            
                            │  C       commit                                              │                            
                            │  p       preview / diff                                      │                            
                            │  j/k     down / up                                           │                            
                            │  g/G     top / bottom                                        │                            
                            │  s       split hunk · not built                              │                            
                            │                                                              │                            
                            ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
